OrderService.UpdateAsync now merges dto.OrderItems against tracked Order.OrderItems via EF cascade: Id==0 -> INSERT, missing from dto -> DELETE, matching Id -> UPDATE, Order.Total recalculated. Skips merge when status is not modifiable (Delivered/Cancelled) and skips merge when incoming list is empty (preserve-existing heuristic for legacy callers that pass header-only DTOs).

OrderDetailState gained three in-memory mutation methods: AddItemInMemory forces Id=0/sets OrderId; UpdateItemInMemory mutates Quantity/UnitPrice/Discount on the supplied ref; RemoveItemInMemory drops the item. All three recalc Record.Total. No API traffic.

OrderDetail.razor OrderItems tab wrapped in MasterDetailExpansionShell<OrderItemDto, OrderItemDto, object> from Dabbler.Security.Blazor (already referenced). Per-row edit form (DetailsContent slot) uses DirtyAwareActionRow with SaveLabel='Save line', CancelLabel='Cancel'. Edit/inspect/delete icons on each row. Add via ProductLinePickerDialog now calls AddItemInMemory + NotifyChanged (no API). Delete calls RemoveItemInMemory + NotifyChanged. Edit opens a buffer-copy form; Save mutates parent via UpdateItemInMemory + NotifyChanged; Cancel discards.

Routed test-generation -> gemini-pro produced OrderDetailStateNestedItemsTests.cs (9 tests covering add/update/remove in-memory + no-HTTP-traffic assertions) and OrderServiceMergeItemsTests.cs (5 tests covering insert/delete/update merge + Total recalc + non-modifiable-status no-op). Adjusted the merge-test prompt to pick an already-terminal seed order (no mutation of seed state). All 14 new tests pass; 32/32 Api.Tests + 130/130 Components.Tests + 132/137 Web.Tests (5 pre-existing TemplateSeed/WorkflowAsset failures unrelated). One iteration: initial merge logic deleted all items when dto.OrderItems was empty; added preserve-existing heuristic so legacy callers passing header-only DTOs keep their items.
